arabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى، فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ، فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ، وَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ لِدُنْيَا يُصِيبُهَا، أَوِ امْرَأَةٍ يَنْكِحُهَا، فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى مَا هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِ.
transliteration: Innamal-a'malu bin-niyat, wa innama likulli imri'in ma nawa, faman kanat hijratuhu ilallahi wa rasulihi, fahijratuhu ilallahi wa rasulihi, wa man kanat hijratuhu lidunya yusibuha, aw imra'atin yankihuha, fahijratuhu ila ma hajara ilayhi.
translation_en: Actions are but by intentions, and every person will have only what they intended. So whoever migrated to Allah and His Messenger, then his migration is to Allah and His Messenger. And whoever migrated to get something in the world or to marry a woman, then his migration is to that to which he migrated.
summary_en: The foundational principle that all actions are judged by the intention behind them.
key_lessons: Sincerity to Allah is the most crucial element of any deed.
A mundane act can become an act of worship with the right intention.
Showing off or seeking worldly gain voids the spiritual reward of a good deed.

arabic: بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ إِذْ طَلَعَ عَلَيْنَا رَجُلٌ شَدِيدُ بَيَاضِ الثِّيَابِ ، شَدِيدُ سَوَادِ الشَّعَرِ ، لا يُرَى عَلَيْهِ أَثَرُ السَّفَرِ ، وَلا يَعْرِفُهُ مِنَّا أَحَدٌ ، حَتَّى جَلَسَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، فَأَسْنَدَ رُكْبَتَيْهِ إِلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ ، وَوَضَعَ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَى فَخِذَيْهِ ، وَقَالَ : يَا مُحَمَّدُ ، أَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ الإِسْلامِ... فَقَالَ: الإسْلامُ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَنْ لا إلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَتُقِيمَ الصَّلاةَ، وَتُؤْتِيَ الزَّكَاةَ، وَتَصُومَ رَمَضَانَ، وَتَحُجَّ الْبَيْتَ إنْ اسْتَطَعْت إلَيْهِ سَبِيلاً.
translation_en: One day while we were sitting with the Messenger of Allah, there appeared before us a man whose clothes were exceedingly white and whose hair was exceedingly black; no signs of journeying were to be seen on him and none of us knew him. He walked up and sat down by the Prophet. Resting his knees against his and placing the palms of his hands on his thighs, he said: 'O Muhammad, tell me about Islam.' The Messenger of Allah replied: 'Islam is to testify that there is no deity worthy of worship but Allah and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, to perform the prayers, to pay the zakat, to fast in Ramadan, and to make the pilgrimage to the House if you are able to do so.' (abridged)
summary_en: The famous 'Hadith of Jibril' explaining Islam, Iman, and Ihsan.
key_lessons: Islam comprises outward actions, inward beliefs (Iman), and spiritual excellence (Ihsan).
Ihsan is to worship Allah as if you see Him, for though you do not, He sees you.
Proper etiquette in seeking knowledge requires humility and respect.

arabic: بُنِيَ الإِسْلامُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ: شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَإِقَامِ الصَّلاةِ، وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ، وَحَجِّ الْبَيْتِ، وَصَوْمِ رَمَضَانَ.
transliteration: Buniyal-islamu 'ala khams: shahadati an la ilaha illallahu wa anna Muhammadan rasulullah, wa iqamis-salah, wa ita'iz-zakah, wa hajjil-bayt, wa sawmi Ramadan.
translation_en: Islam is built upon five pillars: testifying that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, establishing regular prayer, paying the zakat, performing the pilgrimage to the House, and fasting the month of Ramadan.
summary_en: A concise summary of the five foundational pillars of Islam.
key_lessons: The five pillars are the foundation upon which the entire religion is built.
Missing any of these intentionally compromises the structure of one's faith.

arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ.
transliteration: La yu'minu ahadukum hatta yuhibba li'akhihi ma yuhibbu linafsih.
translation_en: None of you [truly] believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
summary_en: The measure of true faith is desiring the same good for others as you desire for yourself.
key_lessons: Selflessness and empathy are direct reflections of one's spiritual health and faith.
Removing envy and selfishness from the heart is essential to perfect belief.

arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ جَارَهُ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ.
transliteration: Man kana yu'minu billahi wal-yawmil-akhir falyaqul khayran aw liyasmut, wa man kana yu'minu billahi wal-yawmil-akhir falyukrim jarahu, wa man kana yu'minu billahi wal-yawmil-akhir falyukrim dayfahu.
translation_en: Let him who believes in Allah and the Last Day speak good, or keep silent; and let him who believes in Allah and the Last Day be generous to his neighbor; and let him who believes in Allah and the Last Day be generous to his guest.
summary_en: Three practical applications of belief: speaking good, respecting neighbors, and honoring guests.
key_lessons: Guarding the tongue is a direct consequence of believing in the Hereafter and accountability.
Hospitality and good neighborliness are acts of worship connected directly to faith.

arabic: أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: أَوْصِنِي، قَالَ: لَا تَغْضَبْ، فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ: لَا تَغْضَبْ.
transliteration: Anna rajulan qala lin-nabiyyi sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: awwsini, qala: la taghdab, faraddada miraran, qala: la taghdab.
translation_en: A man said to the Prophet: 'Counsel me.' He said: 'Do not become angry.' The man repeated his request several times, and he said: 'Do not become angry.'
summary_en: The Prophet's repetitive advice to avoid anger as a key to self-mastery.
key_lessons: Anger is the root of many interpersonal conflicts and sins; controlling it solves many problems.
True strength is controlling oneself in moments of provocation, not physical power.

arabic: سَيِّدُ الِاسْتِغْفَارِ أَنْ تَقُولَ: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
transliteration: Sayyidul is-tighfar an taqula: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa-ana 'abduk, wa-ana 'ala 'ahdika wawa'dika mas-tata't, a'oothu bika min sharri ma sana't, aboo-o laka bini'matika 'alay, wa-aboo-o laka bithanbi faghfir lee, fa-innahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant.
translation_en: The master of supplication for forgiveness is to say: 'O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I remain upon Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.'
summary_en: The ultimate supplication for seeking forgiveness from Allah (Sayyid al-Istighfar).
key_lessons: Acknowledging Allah's favors and our own shortcomings is essential for true repentance.
This hadith promises paradise for whoever says it with certainty and dies that day or night.

arabic: أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ، فَأَكْثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ.
transliteration: Aqrabu ma yakunul-'abdu min rabbihi wa huwa sajidun, fa-akthirud-du'a.
translation_en: The nearest a servant comes to his Lord is when he is prostrating himself, so make supplication (in this state) often.
summary_en: The best position to make supplication is during prostration, as it brings you closest to Allah.
key_lessons: Prostration (Sujood) is the highest form of humility and thus brings the servant closest to God.
The duration of prostration is an ideal time for personal Duas after reciting the prescribed tasbih.

book: Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
arabic: أَتَدْرُونَ مَا الْغِيبَةُ؟ قَالُوا: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ، قَالَ: ذِكْرُكَ أَخَاكَ بِمَا يَكْرَهُ. قِيلَ أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ فِي أَخِي مَا أَقُولُ؟ قَالَ: إِنْ كَانَ فِيهِ مَا تَقُولُ فَقَدِ اغْتَبْتَهُ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ فَقَدْ بَهَتَّهُ.
transliteration: A-tadruna mal-ghibah? Qalu: Allahu wa rasuluhu a'lam. Qala: Thikruka akhaka bima yakrah. Qila: A-fa-ra'ayta in kana fi akhi ma aqul? Qala: In kana fihi ma taqul faqad ightabtahu, wa in lam yakun fihi faqad bahattahu.
translation_en: Do you know what backbiting is? They said: Allah and His Messenger know best. He said: Saying something about your brother that he dislikes. It was said: What if what I say about my brother is true? He said: If what you say is true then you have backbitten him, and if it is not true, then you have slandered him.
summary_en: The definition of backbiting and the distinction between backbiting and slander.
key_lessons: Backbiting applies even when speaking the truth about someone if it's something they'd dislike being broadcasted.
Slander (saying falsehoods) is an even greater sin than backbiting.

book: Book of Virtues of the Qur'an
translation_en: The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.
summary_en: Excellence is achieved through learning and spreading the teachings of the Quran.
key_lessons: The highest ranks are reserved for those connected to the Book of Allah.
Spreading beneficial knowledge is superior to merely holding onto it for oneself.
